limits: This is a bounded research asset set, not complete coverage of all missing food merchants. Unresolved merchants must not receive unrelated chain menus.
All prices are explicit simulated game references unless priceBasis states an observed official price; none is a guaranteed current local quote.
Official online or manufacturer prices can differ from mall branches; game inventory, stock and sizes are simulated.
Actual international or historical official photographs are identified in notes; local presentation and current availability can differ.
Prepared meals and ready-to-drink items can have gameplay effects; packaged coffee beans/capsules require brewing and have no immediate consumption effects.
Retailers carrying manufacturer brands include retailerBrandEvidence; this documents the brand or model relationship, not current branch stock.
Interior references distinguish photographed facts from suggested adaptations. Most are brand prototypes, not exact architectural replicas of mall branches.
The Kahala Frappe asset is an official family photograph containing multiple drinks; the matching caramel drink is in front.

Dining-experience rows for H&H and Fogo are real restaurant services; their photos show a meat component, not a fixed standalone steak SKU. H&H is an observed lunch-menu reference; Fogo USD price is explicitly simulated.
